expectations.text: One-to-many sides (e.g., posts Post[]) produce relationships of type one_to_many; their corresponding many-to-one inverse (e.g., author User @relation(...)) produces type many_to_one, both with the correct target_entity

eval_feedback.overall: 7/7 PASS (up from 4/7 in iter-7). P1 fix lands: prisma.yaml capture-group patterns + extractor.ts relMatch[1] preference. Three assertions flipped (A3, A4, A6) from one upstream change — same leverage pattern as T3 (TypeORM). All 6 remaining ORM profiles (jpa, sqlalchemy, django, activerecord, entity_framework, typeorm) unaffected: they don't use capture groups, so the extractor falls through to the existing tail-based resolver path.
